tracks.title: Coerced Recruitment & Crisis Helpline Routing Kits
tracks.summary: Builds verified multi-jurisdiction helpline directories and safe-intake triage scripts for NGOs assisting people recruited into coercive work sites, keeping all crisis planning strictly human-only.

organizations.org_type: Anti-exploitation helpline and consular referral desk
organizations.serves: Job-seekers and families checking suspicious overseas tech or customer-support offers
organizations.mandate: Route urgent inquiries to verified hotlines and trained caseworkers without exposing callers

never: Give automated safety or exit advice directly to a person in danger
Collect location data about real individuals
Publish unverified phone numbers or unconfirmed helpline hours

sources.title: UNODC Issue Paper: Casinos, Cyber Fraud, and Trafficking in Persons in Southeast Asia
ILO Operational Indicators of Trafficking in Human Beings

tracks.title: Small-Nonprofit Grant Reporting & Restricted-Fund Kits
tracks.summary: Gives small nonprofits with no dedicated finance staff deterministic budget-reconciliation checks, restricted-grant deadline trackers, and audit-prep checklists.

organizations.serves: Program directors and volunteer treasurers managing multiple public and foundation grants
organizations.mandate: Keep restricted grant spending reconciled, documented, and ready for annual filings

never: Submit regulatory filings or grant reports externally without treasurer sign-off
Invent missing expense figures or estimate unrecorded receipts as zero

sources.title: IRS Compliance Guide for 501(c)(3) Public Charities (Publication 4221-PC)

tracks.title: Rental Deposit & Disaster-Relief Charity Check Kits
tracks.summary: Provides community legal-aid clinics and disaster-response coalitions with public-registry lookup schemas, deposit-escrow checklists, and fee-comparison checks.

organizations.org_type: Tenant legal-aid clinic and disaster-relief coalition
organizations.serves: Renters asked for upfront wire deposits and donors verifying post-disaster appeals
organizations.mandate: Check public charity registries and lease deposit terms before funds are wired

never: Label an unregistered community mutual-aid group as dishonest without human review
File regulator complaints automatically without human sign-off

sources.title: IRS Tax Exempt Organization Search Guidance
US FTC Consumer Advice: Rental Listing Indicators

tracks.title: Multilingual Service-Finder & Warm-Referral Operations
tracks.summary: Helps community nonprofits, food pantries, shelters, and legal-aid desks match published program rules to intake notes and draft plain-language warm-referral summaries while keeping eligibility decisions human-only.

organizations.org_type: Community social-services nonprofit and legal-aid intake desk
organizations.serves: Residents seeking housing stability, food assistance, benefits navigation, or clinic appointments
organizations.mandate: Reduce intake paperwork time so caseworkers spend more time directly helping people

never: Allow an agent to deny service eligibility on its own
Send client details to partner organizations without human approval and consent

sources.title: Open Referral Human Services Data Specification (HSDS)

tracks.title: Cross-Border Job Offer & Fee-Shift Intake Kits
tracks.summary: Equips migrant-worker centres and labour-rights clinics with agent-assisted fee arithmetic checks, contract comparison checklists, and escalation workflows drawn from the recruitment indicators in the exploitation-evidence pack.

organizations.serves: Workers reviewing overseas employment contracts, agency fee receipts, and loan schedules
organizations.mandate: Explain fee caps, compare contract versions, and connect workers to legal aid or labour inspectors

never: Contact or notify a recruitment agency, employer, or lender
Store real worker identity documents or real case files in the kit repository
Allow an agent to decide a worker's legal claim or conduct a client interview

sources.title: ILO C181 Private Employment Agencies Convention, Article 7
Hong Kong Employment Agencies Portal: Code of Practice for Employment Agencies

tracks.title: Public Rules and Policy Briefs
tracks.summary: Helps nonprofits follow new public rules and ordinances with plain-language briefs that cite the clause behind every point, while staff and counsel decide what a rule means and what is said publicly.

organizations.serves: Staff, boards and partners who need to understand new public rules
organizations.mandate: Understand new rules accurately from the official text, and leave interpretation to staff and counsel

never: Say how a rule applies to a particular person, or give legal advice
Cite anything other than the official text
Publish or share a brief on the organization's behalf

sources.title: National Archives: The Federal Register, What It Is and How to Use It

tracks.title: Program Impact and Funding Reports
tracks.summary: Helps small nonprofits turn their own program records into monthly impact reports and funding impact summaries with every figure traced and every gap visible, while staff check the figures, approve the text and share or submit it.

organizations.org_type: Community nonprofit with program staff and a small board
organizations.serves: Program managers, executive directors, boards and funders
organizations.mandate: Report what programs did and achieved honestly, with every number traceable to the organization's own records

never: Invent, estimate or round away a missing number
Quote a participant without staff approval, or with a name
Share or submit a report on the organization's behalf

sources.title: eCFR: 2 CFR 200.329, Monitoring and reporting program performance

tracks.title: Handwritten Statements and Records
tracks.summary: Helps community organizations turn handwritten statements, cards and forms into text typed exactly as written, with every uncertain reading flagged for a person and local terms listed in a glossary, while staff check, follow up and decide how statements are used.

organizations.org_type: Community center or services nonprofit that collects handwritten statements and forms
organizations.serves: Community members who write statements, and the staff and interns who type them up
organizations.mandate: Keep every statement in the writer's own words, protect it, and use it only with consent

never: Correct, tidy, summarize or translate a writer's words in the transcription
Guess an unclear word without flagging it for a person
Share a statement without the writer's consent

sources.title: National Archives: Citizen Archivist resources for transcribing records

tracks.title: Victim Support Referrals
tracks.summary: Helps victim services programs prepare referral options from public services directories using only the service needs an advocate enters, while advocates hold every conversation, do all safety planning and make every referral with the person's consent.

organizations.org_type: Victim services program or helpline with trained advocates
organizations.serves: People seeking support after harm, and the advocates who help them
organizations.mandate: Offer choices from verified public services, let each person decide, and keep their story and safety with trained advocates

never: Read, ask for or store a person's story, name, contact details or location
Describe anyone as responsible for harm
Contact a service or a person on the program's behalf

sources.title: Office for Victims of Crime: Directory of Crime Victim Services

tracks.title: Field Volunteer Onboarding & Incident Escalation SOPs
tracks.summary: Equips mutual-aid kitchens, mobile clinics, and disaster-relief teams with role-card builders, shift handoff checklists, and clear human-escalation trees.

organizations.org_type: Mutual-aid relief hub and volunteer-run clinic
organizations.serves: Volunteer coordinators onboarding rotating community helpers under time pressure
organizations.mandate: Give every shift clear safety steps, role boundaries, and immediate coordinator escalation paths

never: Replace human incident commanders or medical leads with automated triage
Store real volunteer personal contact lists inside public templates

sources.title: Ready.gov Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) Basic Training Materials
